assets.rightsBasis: Official TNTEU logo served from the university's own domain and used site-wide in the header and footer. No open licence or ownership transfer claimed; used only to identify the institution. Checked 2026-10-25: HTTP 200, content-type image/png, 26,435 bytes, 157x126 px, RGBA. Rendered on a white tile and visually confirmed: blue circular crest with the Tamil and English university names, green shield with book/figures and the 'Truth Alone Triumphs' motto scroll, all legible. CAVEAT: small raster (157 px wide); no larger or SVG official variant found; several guessed logo paths returned 404.

Official campus photograph served from the university's own domain and used on the Faculty Building infrastructure page. No open licence stated; official institutional image used to identify the campus, same basis as earlier official covers in research/media-enrichment. Checked 2026-10-25: HTTP 200, content-type image/jpeg, 351,154 bytes, 1024x768 px (landscape). Visual confirmation: single real exterior of the three-storey Faculty Building with the university name board over the entrance, planted forecourt, parked two-wheelers and one distant figure at the left edge; no identifiable close-up faces. The related 'Faculty Building.jpg' was rejected because it is a composite with an added green band.
